title: MATH 223, where nothing can be graded yet
question: In a course with no checker, does the tutor give feedback and never a verdict?
turns: /tutor for MATH 223: I have a counting homework problem
The problem asks how many 5-card hands have exactly two aces. I got C(4,2) * C(48,3). Is that correct?
Just grade it like the other course, give me a verdict.
